# Bun fullstack base

> A Hono API and a React app served by one Bun server. Zod schemas validate every request, generate the OpenAPI
> document, and type the client.

## API

- [OpenAPI document](/api/openapi.json): every endpoint, its parameters and its answers
- [Greeting](/api/hello/world): `GET /api/hello/{name}`, a greeting for a name
- [Notes](/api/notes): `GET /api/notes`, a page of notes, newest first (`?limit=20&before=` a page's `next`), and `POST /api/notes` with `{ "text" }` to add one
- [Health](/api/health): `GET /api/health`, whether the API is up
